# Plan Checklist: Diseño profesional y navegación por barras

**Purpose**: Validar la calidad del plan técnico (completitud, claridad, consistencia, trazabilidad con la spec) antes de generar tareas.
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Traceability with the Spec

- [x] CHK001 Does every functional requirement FR-001..FR-012 map to a component, class or file named in the plan or the UI contract? [Traceability, Plan §Source Code]
- [x] CHK002 Is each success criterion SC-001..SC-005 covered by a validation step in the quickstart? [Traceability, Gap]
- [x] CHK003 Is the plan's "Scale/Scope" (4 pantallas, 1 hoja de estilos, 1 barra) consistent with the four sections in the spec? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context]

## Design Completeness

- [x] CHK004 Are the palette values, typography and spacing scale specified in a single authoritative place (research or contract) rather than left implicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Is the breakpoint for the narrow layout stated consistently across plan, research and contract (600 px vs the 360 px minimum in the spec)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for how the active section is determined on first load and after navigation? [Gap, Plan §main.js]
- [x] CHK007 Are the class names in the contract complete for every UI element the four screens generate (e.g., logo preview, línea de presupuesto, acciones de tabla)? [Completeness, Contract]
- [x] CHK008 Is the handling of inline styles currently in `index.html` (keep, replace or remove) defined? [Gap, Plan §Source Code]
- [x] CHK009 Are focus-visible and keyboard requirements for the navigation bar defined in the contract? [Gap, Accessibility]

## Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK010 Is the contrast target (≥ 4.5:1) tied to the specific color pairs in the palette so it can be objectively checked? [Measurability, Plan §Constraints, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 Is "sin impacto perceptible" in performance goals defined or intentionally left non-measurable? [Ambiguity, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK012 Is the visual emphasis of the final total described with measurable properties in the contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Constraints & Constitution

- [x] CHK013 Does the plan state explicitly which files must remain behaviorally unchanged (calculo, numeracion, pdf, storage)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK014 Is the rule that changes to `src/ui/*.js` are limited to markup/classes (no logic changes) stated as a constraint? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK015 Are the Constitution Check conclusions justified per principle with evidence rather than only asserted? [Clarity, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK016 Is the exclusion of dark mode, animations and external fonts/icons documented consistently between spec, plan and research? [Consistency, Assumption]

## Scenario & Edge Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are plan-level decisions present for long text, large logos and tables wider than the viewport? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Is the visual treatment for field-level validation errors (not just message blocks) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK019 Are disabled/empty-state requirements for the Descargar PDF action defined? [Gap]
- [x] CHK020 Is the verification approach (manual quickstart plus existing tests) sufficient and explicitly justified for a presentation-only change? [Assumption, Research §Verificación]

## Findings

Todos los huecos se resolvieron en spec.md (FR-013..018, FR-002/005/007/008/011, Assumptions), plan.md, research.md, contracts/ui-components.md y tasks.md. Revisado con asistencia; el revisor puede reabrir cualquier item.

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
